description.value: Pho Canada is a Vietnamese restaurant in Surrey serving an extensive menu of pho noodle soups, stews, fried plates, and appetizers including salad rolls and spring rolls. The menu spans dozens of pho variations — beef, chicken, seafood, and vegetarian — making it a substantial stop for a hungry touring cyclist. The restaurant is located in a unit at a Surrey strip-style address on 100 Avenue.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at phocanada.ca is live and presents a full Vietnamese restaurant menu, confirming the business is open. The website header shows phone number (604) 498-3609 not present in OSM. Multiple vegetarian menu items are explicitly listed (Salad Rolls Veggie, Spring Rolls Veggie, Vegetarian Noodle Soup, Veggie Fried Rice, Vegetarian Chow Mein), supporting a true value for that amenity. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, takeout) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone (604) 498-3609 was sourced from the website header only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Vietnamese restaurant with an active website and full menu. A solid meal stop for touring cyclists in Surrey.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly lists vegetarian options: Salad Rolls (Veggie), Spring Rolls (Veggie), Vegetarian Noodle Soup (Phở Chay), Vegetarian Noodle Dry (Hủ Tiếu Chay Khô), Veggie Fried Rice (Cơm Chiên Chay), and Vegetarian Chow Mein (Mì Xào Dòn Rau Cải Chay)
